symptom: Tool rows with a file or link target beside the name (Read, Edit, Write, linked commands) painted an unpadded fill on the bare name, while Bash rows hovered as a padded 28px row with 6px corners.
rule: A row whose targets sit beside its disclosure is one ListRowGroup: 8px sides, 6px corners, one hover fill and focus ring, and a click in its gaps toggles; the tool-presentation smoke measures both kinds.
